title: [UE-0.3] Project skeleton (Nov 12)
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Technical Director

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Dev Lead

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `UmbrellaElla.uproject`, `Source/**` (new), `Config/**`, `Content/UmbrellaElla/Input/**`, `Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_Graybox.umap`, `tools/ue/test.sh`, `tools/ue/test.ps1`, `tools/module_check.py`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `UmbrellaElla.uproject`, `Source/**` (new), `Config/**`, `Content/UmbrellaElla/Input/**`, `Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_Graybox.umap`, `tools/ue/test.sh`, `tools/ue/test.ps1`, `tools/module_check.py`
Do not touch: other maps under Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/
Locks: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_Graybox.umap

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.0

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.4a, UE-0.5, UE-0.6, UE-0.8, UE-0.9, UE-0.20, UE-0.27

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] Contents as in `technical-director.md` Outputs, including GameDefaultMap `/Game/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_Graybox` (an empty level made here; card 0.8 builds it out), a C++ GameMode whose DefaultPawnClass is the Ella shell set as GlobalDefaultGameMode, and a provisional Default Pixels Per Unreal Unit set before any import. `Config/DefaultEngine.ini` also sets `UIScaleRule=ShortestSide` so `python3 tools/ui_check.py ci` passes on this PR (card 0.20 adds the DPI curve)
- [ ] Three targets set the workbench switch (D-new-workbench-debug, `pipeline/unreal-rules.md` Workbench): `UmbrellaElla.Target.cs` `UMBRELLAELLA_WORKBENCH=0`, `UmbrellaEllaEditor.Target.cs` and `UmbrellaEllaWorkbench.Target.cs` `=1`; `python3 tools/ue_run.py workbench-check` prints PASS, and FAILS once with the submission target flipped to 1 on purpose (both pasted)
- [ ] Runs on: the Windows packaging machine: a kickoff there (`tools\kickoff.ps1`) builds and fixes this card, a kickoff elsewhere leaves it waiting (`tools/kickoff.py` RUNS_ON_WINDOWS); that session runs every Windows line below
- [ ] `tools/ue/build.sh` and `tools\ue\build.ps1` exit 0 on Mac and on Windows (log tails pasted)
- [ ] `tools/ue/test.sh --bootstrap` and `test.ps1 -Bootstrap` run the placeholder test `UmbrellaElla.Bootstrap.Placeholder`; `check_automation_report.py` prints PASS tests=1 on both OSes, same commit (both summary lines pasted)
- [ ] `tools\ue\package.ps1` exits 0 on the Windows packaging machine (log tail pasted)
- [ ] The PR pastes `package exit: 0` and `SMOKE_BOOTSTRAP: no smoke hook before card 0.6` in place of SMOKE_OK; `check_pr.py` accepts that line only while `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Smoke/` does not exist (Day-1 bootstrap, `tools/check_pr.py`)
- [ ] Paste whether `Automation RunTests` (what `tools/ue/test.sh` and `test.ps1` run) found the tests; if only `Automation RunTest` does, file a bug card for the scripts (this card has no gate patch)
- [ ] The PR also pastes (`technical-director.md` Done when): the `NONUNITY=1 tools/ue/build.sh` line, a 5.8.4 `index.json` excerpt showing each test's `duration` field, the compile log of one `final` UCLASS, and `python3 tools/module_check.py --rules K` exit 0 on the real `Source/`. Card 0.4a copies the `final` log into `pipeline/unreal/cpp-rules.md` (its lane) and removes its [VERIFY]; rule K then runs by default (`module_check.py` k_proven)
- [ ] kickoff tags `jam-start` on `main` itself when this card starts (only on or after the start, never in a practice repo), the pre-jam record the Sponsor may ask for (Official Rules §7(h), `docs/pre-jam-declaration.md`); `git tag -l jam-start` prints it (pasted)

### Budget and cut tier

120 min agent + 60 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
